jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated 2D medieval Serbian fantasy platformer WORLD PROP, hand-painted cel-shaded style matching reference. Crisp painted stone/wood textures, warm earthy tones, dark outlines. Full object inside canvas, TRUE TRANSPARENT background and gaps, no scenery, no ground plane, no shadows, no text/UI. A HORIZONTALLY TILEABLE floating fairy stone bridge segment consisting of EXACTLY TWO flat stone slabs joined by thin glowing GREEN-TURQUOISE fairy light. Shallow horizontal platform, width 4 times height. Perfectly STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL TOP WALKING EDGE at one fixed height. Gray stone slabs have engraved spiral/diamond patterns matching reference menhir. Slabs fill canvas LEFT TO RIGHT to edges with matching thickness, contour and lighting on opposite edges for seamless repetition. No left/right caps, pillars, arches, supports or terrain. Underside gently jagged, subtle magic joins, no light above walking top. Transparent above/below bridge.

Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated 2D medieval Serbian fantasy platformer WORLD PROP, hand-painted cel-shaded style matching reference. Crisp painted stone/wood textures, warm earthy tones, dark outlines. Full object inside canvas, TRUE TRANSPARENT background and gaps, no scenery, no ground plane, no shadows, no text/UI. One END CAP for the SAME floating fairy stone bridge as second reference. Gray flat slab with same turquoise-green engraved fairy spirals and diamond marks. RIGHT side is flat straight bridge connector matching segment's top edge and thickness, LEFT side is broader rough resting shoulder to sit on a cliff edge; do not draw actual cliff. Flat level walkable top; subtly glowing underside/joint. Whole endcap isolated, no arch or support. Designed to mirror horizontally for opposite end.
